name: Official WOMD Data Pipeline
purpose: Export official WOMD motion scenarios into a provenance-preserving corpus for predictive connectivity evaluation.
acceptance_criteria: scenario identity and true SDC identity are retained
training/development ownership is assigned at scenario level
official validation is exported separately and labeled official_validation
history uses only states through the prediction anchor
future actor-minus-SDC geometry is retained for downstream link realization
corpus hashes and schema audits are recorded
stage remains BLOCKED until real official WOMD corpora pass the audits
forbidden: synthetic trajectories promoted as WOMD evidence
treating future SDC motion as zero
